findings.query: Egypt Ministry of Youth and Sports private coaching licensing regulations
findings.finding: Egypt’s Sports Law No 71 of 2017 lets the minister set registration fees up to 1 million EGP, while Law No 171 of 2025 bans matches with foreign teams without permission. A recent cooperation protocol between the Ministry of Youth and Sports and the NTRA highlights joint initiatives on football pitches and combined education‑sports training. Regulations also require coaches not be alone with participants in private settings and set rules for private youth lessons.
findings.risk_flag: Regulatory compliance requirements for licensing and coach‑participant safety
